name: sf90-hammer-bleed
note: Run 0bd944d0 (2026-08-15): the worker wrote "$193,000-$262,000 (bids, not sold) vs $850,000 retail value" and the old parser made an $850,000 hammer. Typed comps carry one price each; the retail figure is a note. Three heavy structural front zones must price as one program. hand-converted 2026-08-17 from the recorded freeform findings into typed comps, each as its source stated it.

areas.description: Both front corners are torn off with bumper, splitter, headlights, and fenders missing. Photos show the front crash structure/bumper beam visibly bent and torn rather than just cosmetic panels missing, indicating impact reached load-bearing front structure.
Right front fender, bumper, and headlight completely gone, exposing front knuckle, caliper, and torn harness; suspension geometry and crash rail exposed suggesting more than skin-deep damage.
Left front fender/bumper also missing, wheel sitting at an angle in profile shot consistent with suspension or corner structure displacement.
Rear bumper fascia and diffuser trim removed for inspection/parts, exposing hybrid motor, exhaust, and wiring; underlying rear structure and taillights appear intact with no visible crush.
Front wheel angles in side and 3/4 shots plus exposed knuckles/calipers suggest bent or damaged front suspension components on at least one, possibly both, corners.

Multiple exposed wiring harnesses at front and rear (near hybrid components) with disconnected connectors; dash shows system fault warnings likely tied to sensor/harness disruption from the front impact and disassembly for parts removal.
Hood and cowl show only minor gap/alignment irregularity near the damaged lower corners; panel itself unbent.
Interior is clean and undamaged, no airbag deployment, seats and dash intact.

observations.note: Front right corner totally torn away - bumper, headlight, fender missing, exposing suspension knuckle, brake caliper, and torn wiring; front clip severely mangled.
Left side profile shows left front fender/bumper gone, front wheel exposed at odd angle suggesting suspension damage; rear bumper cover also removed showing hybrid components and wiring hanging.
Rear 3/4 view: rear bumper fascia entirely removed, exposing exhaust, hybrid electric motor unit, wiring; taillight assembly intact but surrounding structure exposed.
Front left/right view confirms front clip destruction - bumper, splitter, headlights missing, radiator support and crash structure visible and deformed; hood and cabin appear undamaged.
Straight-on front view shows both headlights gone, bumper beam/crash structure visibly bent and torn on left side, hood edge deformed at lower corners.

Direct rear view: rear bumper fully removed, diffuser and crash structure visible but appears largely intact aside from missing fascia; exhaust tips and hybrid module exposed but not obviously crushed.
Interior driver side - seats, dash, steering wheel all clean and undamaged, no airbag deployment visible.
Interior wide shot - dash, center console, seats intact, no deployed airbags, no fire/water staining.
Instrument cluster shows only 3004 miles, warning lights for system faults (likely from disconnected sensors/harness) consistent with front-end wiring damage, no fire/flood indication.
Rear engine cover/glass area - cosmetic only, panel gaps normal, no structural deformation visible.
Hood/cowl area shows only minor panel gap misalignment, otherwise cosmetically clean.
VIN plate photo confirming identity, no damage info.

triage.drivetrainRisk: The V8/hybrid powertrain sits mid-rear and photos of that area (2,5,9) show the exhaust and hybrid motor module intact with no visible impact deformation, suggesting the engine/gearbox itself likely escaped direct force. However, the severe front-end intrusion reaching the front crash structure and suspension raises real concern about front subframe alignment and high-voltage front wiring integrity - a full HV isolation and frame-alignment check is essential before any drivetrain assumptions are made.
